purpose: An additive, auditable evidence model for the future task-based lesson engine; does not reinterpret historical drills as fluency.

taskEvidenceMap.onlyIf: no model, example or sentence starter displayed; supplied lexical cue remains recorded
no answer model/hint displayed; lexical cue alone does not demonstrate lexical retrieval
new context, model hidden; lexical cue recorded
attempt date actually occurs after prior pilot; interval measured, not assumed

assistanceSemantics.lexicalCueScope: Can support construction of a phrase but cannot establish independent recall of the supplied word.
assistanceSemantics.modelAnswerScope: If shown before answer, suppress independent-production or transfer competency claims for that attempt.
assistanceSemantics.phoneticKeyboardScope: An accessibility/editing scaffold; does not by itself evaluate Cyrilic reading, pronunciation or autonomous typing.

eventFieldContract.eventId: Unique and idempotent within browser; never reuse for another response.
eventFieldContract.language: en or ru, matches unit and task.
eventFieldContract.unitId: Stable ID of original pilot. Never impersonate a legacy exercise.
eventFieldContract.contentVersion: Immutable positive integer in content artifact; do not silently reinterpret old event versions.
eventFieldContract.taskId: Unique within all new lesson, diagnostic, reading and delayed task IDs.
eventFieldContract.taskKind: Declared type in task; source of evidence classification.
eventFieldContract.evidenceKind: Mapped from task kind; not derived from a percentage of correct legacy attempts.
eventFieldContract.response: Learner's own answer, local by default; privacy limits before any remote integration.
eventFieldContract.shownAssistance: Exact help shown before submission; includes support already printed in prompt, for example biblioteca.
eventFieldContract.outcome: Supported, partiallySupported, notSupported, uncertain or notAssessed; no automatic positive open-text verdict.
eventFieldContract.reviewStatus: pending, reviewed or notRequired; pending is not passed.
eventFieldContract.feedback: Task-specific rationale; null until reliable feedback exists.
eventFieldContract.sourceContext: Versioned task and stimulus context key to distinguish repetition from transfer.
eventFieldContract.isIndependentClaimAllowed: False if model/sentence starter shown; cue-limited subskills must remain explicit.

recommendationRules.then: Suggest first available intro unit with optional free navigation; do not invent a level.
Suggest an appropriate written application, never infer speaking or independent production.

recommendationRules.when: Open response pending review or unclear
recommendationRules.then: Mark uncertain, offer a new attempt or review; do not mark mastery.
Recommend practice/transfer or a new objective and explain which observations support it.
Keep notAssessed and allow retry; do not record a zero.

futurePersistenceRequirements.backupFormatAfterMigration: version 3 proposed, after migration design and compatibility testing
futurePersistenceRequirements.writeAtomicity: No partially saved lesson attempts; repeat submission idempotent.
futurePersistenceRequirements.draftResume: Persist input and position separately from evaluated evidence; no phantom attempt on reload.
futurePersistenceRequirements.storageFailure: Preserve typed response in view, show actionable failure; never announce successful save.

releaseGates: Human review of English and Russian naturalness, alternatives and register
Learner test of both pilots and diagnostic tasks
Reliable reviewer or explicit uncertain handling for open responses
End-to-end event persistence + legacy backup compatibility
Feature flag explicitly authorized and all checks green
